question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3 - exacerbated**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage talks about climbers’ misery being made worse by external factors like insufficient support and bad weather.
 
• The word "**exacerbated**" means to make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse. (और अधिक बिगाड़ना / गंभीर बनाना)
 
• Therefore, "**exacerbated**" fits perfectly in the blank as it conveys that misery is intensified by lack of support.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is '**Option 3 - exacerbated**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Perfectly** (संपूर्ण रूप से): Means completely or without fault. Does not fit the context of intensifying misery.

 
 
• **Example:** She solved the puzzle perfectly.
 
 
 
• **Increasingly** (बढ़ते हुए): Means more and more over time. It suggests gradual growth but not worsening of misery directly.
 
 
• **Example:** He is becoming increasingly confident in his work.
 
 
 
• **Worst** (सबसे बुरा): Superlative form of "bad." Grammatically incorrect here since the sentence requires a verb-like expression, not an adjective.
 
 
• **Example:** This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
